name: 0vix
fix_description: In totalGHST, uses manipulable on-chain price/balance values. Fix: use TWAP oracle or add flash-loan protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC involves a long multi-stage attack chain with nested Aave V3/V2 and Balancer flashloans, lending-market collateral setup, oracle manipulation on a deflationary token wrapper, leveraged debt creation via a helper contract, liquidation loops, and unwinding through many DEX pools. Writing it requires deep protocol-specific understanding of 0Vix/Compound-style accounting plus multiple Polygon liquidity venues, which is well beyond a straightforward exploit.
